text: Stores documents and embeddings and serves full-text, semantic, and conversational search from a single API
quote: It stores your documents and embeddings, then exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API.

text: Quickstart walks through creating a project and index, adding documents, and running a first search in a web interface
quote: setting up Meilisearch Cloud, creating a project and an index, adding documents to it, and performing your first search with the default web interface

text: Typo tolerance returns relevant results despite misspellings, configurable per index
quote: Typo tolerance helps users find relevant results even when their search queries contain spelling mistakes or typos, for example, typing `phnoe` instead of `phone`.

text: Minimum word size thresholds for typo tolerance can be overridden
quote: You can override these default settings using the minWordSizeForTypos object.

text: Seven built-in ranking rules whose order can be changed to fit your needs
quote: Meilisearch contains seven built-in ranking rules in the following order... Depending on your needs, you might want to change this order.

text: Define synonym lists so equivalent words match each other
quote: If multiple words have an equivalent meaning in your dataset, you can create a list of synonyms. This will make your search results more relevant.

text: Dynamic search rules boost, pin, or bury results based on request context
quote: Dynamic Search Rules ... Boost, pin, or bury results based on the context of each request

text: Faceting returns aggregated counts per field value for category and ecommerce-style navigation
quote: Faceting returns aggregated counts for field values, powering category navigation in your UI

text: Dedicated facet search endpoint searches values of a single facet for type-ahead filter menus
quote: Facet search is a dedicated endpoint for searching through the values of a single facet. It is typically used to power auto-complete and type-ahead interfaces on top of filter menus

text: Filtering and sorting work alongside faceting to refine search results
quote: Filtering, sorting, and faceting are three complementary tools for refining search results

text: Geosearch support for location-based relevancy
quote: Leverage reliable and performant search with features like geosearch and faceting for improved relevancy.

text: Configured embedders automatically generate vector embeddings for every document
quote: When you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document in your index. You don't need to compute or manage embeddings yourself.

text: Hybrid search combines keyword full-text search with semantic search
quote: Hybrid search combines two search strategies: full-text search (matching keywords) and semantic search (matching meaning).

text: Multimodal search lets users find images, video, and audio by meaning via a unified vector space
quote: Every content type is transformed into a unified vector space, enabling cross-modal search in milliseconds.

text: Conversational search answers user questions grounded in your own content
quote: Let users ask questions and get real answers, grounded in your own content. No hallucinations, no guessing.

text: Serves as a retrieval layer giving AI models accurate, current context from your data
quote: The retrieval layer your AI applications need. Give your models accurate, current context from your own data.

text: Analytics track search queries, clicks, and conversions to measure search quality
quote: Meilisearch analytics helps you understand how users interact with your search. Track search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality

text: Personalization adapts result ranking to each user's preferences and behavior
quote: Three users search for "laptop". Each sees results ranked by their unique preferences, no extra configuration needed.

text: Tenant tokens are short-lived scoped credentials with embedded filters restricting users to their own data
quote: Tenant tokens are short-lived, scoped credentials generated from an API key. They embed search rules (filters) that automatically apply to every search request, ensuring users only see their own data.

text: Multi-tenancy without separate indexes or infrastructure per customer
quote: Meilisearch handles multi-tenancy at the search level. Each tenant gets isolated access through secure tokens. No need for separate indexes or infrastructure per customer.

text: API keys authenticate requests and control access to data
quote: API keys authenticate requests, while tenant tokens restrict what data each user can see within a shared index.

text: Single dependency-free binary that runs on Linux, macOS, or Windows, bare metal or containers
quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.

text: Install locally via cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source
quote: Install Meilisearch locally on Linux, macOS, or Windows using cURL, Docker, Homebrew, APT, or from source.

text: Production self-hosting guidance covers reverse proxy, process manager, and master key
quote: For production deployments, you will also need: A reverse proxy (Nginx or Caddy) for HTTPS termination A process manager (systemd)... A master key for authentication

text: Native clustering support for read high availability
quote: Guarantees the Read High Availability of the service with native support for clusterization.

text: Official Helm charts for deploying on Kubernetes
quote: Helm charts for deploying Meilisearch on Kubernetes.

text: Official Docker images for deployment and development
quote: Official Meilisearch Docker images for easy deployment and development.

text: Create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and search through natural-language prompts
quote: Once configured, you can create indexes, add documents, configure settings, and perform searches using natural language prompts.

text: Update ranking rules, searchable attributes, and faceting via natural-language prompts in your AI client
quote: Update ranking rules, searchable attributes, and faceting through natural-language prompts.

text: Native MCP server at POST /mcp lets MCP-compatible clients search indexes directly
quote: Meilisearch ships a native MCP server at the POST /mcp route so any MCP-compatible client can search your indexes directly.

text: Federated multi-search queries every index in parallel and merges results into one ranked list
quote: One query searches every index in parallel. Results are merged and ranked into a single list, no client-side logic required.

text: Typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET
quote: Typed SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart, and .NET.

text: Official JavaScript client with TypeScript support running in Node.js, browsers, and edge runtimes
quote: The official JavaScript client for Meilisearch, with full TypeScript support for Node.js and browser environments.

text: Official Python client with async/await support and type hints
quote: The official Python client for Meilisearch with async support and type hints.

text: First-party Laravel Scout driver
quote: First-party Meilisearch driver for Laravel Scout, the official Laravel search package.

text: Pairs with React InstantSearch to build search interfaces
quote: Build performant, responsive search interfaces by pairing Meilisearch with React InstantSearch.

text: Cache results and indexes for offline-first apps that search without a network
quote: Cache results and indexes for offline-first apps. Search without a network connection.

text: Database sync tools for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
quote: Database sync. Sync MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.

text: Sync Firebase collections with Meilisearch
quote: Sync Firebase collections with Meilisearch for powerful search.

text: ActiveRecord integration auto-syncs Rails models
quote: ActiveRecord sync. Auto-sync models with Meilisearch.

quote: 14-day free trial, no credit card required
